The '''D-22 speeder bike''', also known as the "'''screamer'''," was produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and considered a high-performance [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] machine. It had a maximum altitude of 35 meters and a close sensor range. The asking price of a D-22 was around 4,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SoF" />

The D-22 was the preferred vehicle of the Corellian [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] which used them in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]]. A swoop gang known as the [[Black Seraphs]] used it for criminal purposes.<ref name="SoF" />
